reconstruction_rule: filter pert_type=trt_cp, pert_idose=10 µM, pert_itime=24 h; then keep the first source-order row per pert_iname+cell_id
limitations: The reconstruction identifies the exact source signature but does not repeat the expression ranking.
Chemical structures still require row-level identity review when Broad and Hub annotations disagree.
The signatures are A549 in vitro perturbations and do not establish treatment efficacy.
